meta.title: A closed RFQ: "Increase Event Time": "Cancel" closes it and changes nothing
warnings: resolved: “Direct before-and-after comparison of the event status and submission times after cancelling the Increase Event Time dia” — remember + expect_remembered compare a value across elements, screens or portals (as numbers with as/delta); expect_api_value compares with the API

steps.note: Open the API-prepared closed RFQ with one invited vendor bid.
Open the Responses tab specified by the case.
Record that the existing vendor is still represented before opening the time dialog.
Record the existing bid value before the cancellation action.
Open the Increase Event Time window from the RFQ Settings menu.
Cancel the Increase Event Time window.
Assert that cancelling closes the dialog.
Assert that the event remains on the Responses view after cancellation.
Verify the existing vendor remains unchanged after cancellation.
Verify the existing bid value remains unchanged after cancellation.
